tactic-1.title: Playing with feelings
tactic-1.description: Using your feelings (like anger and sadness) to trick you into doing something.
tactic-1.example: A TikTok comment says, 'If you don’t repost this, your Among Us account will get DELETED!'

tactic-2.title: Jokes that mislead people
tactic-2.description: Using humour or memes to spread false or misleading information.
tactic-2.example: A Minecraft meme says: 'NEW GLITCH: PRESS ALT+F4 TO GET FREE DIAMONDS! 💎' — kids try it, but pressing ALT+F4 just closes their game!'

tactic-3.title: Fake Videos/Audio
tactic-3.description: Fake videos or images made with AI that show people doing or saying things they never did.
tactic-3.example: A YouTube short shows Taylor Swift saying, 'I hate cats!' — but it’s AI-generated.

tactic-4.title: Only showing the good parts
tactic-4.description: Leaving out important information to make something look better or worse than it really is.
tactic-4.example: Your friend brags, 'I got 100% on one math test!' but doesn’t mention the five F’s he got.

tactic-5.title: Trick headlines
tactic-5.description: Headlines that grab your attention, but the story is fake or not as important as it seems.
tactic-5.example: OMG! What this ROBOT can do will SHOCK you! → It’s just an ad for a toy car.

tactic-6.title: Crazy secret stories
tactic-6.description: A story that claims a powerful group is secretly behind an event without strong evidence.
tactic-6.example: Roblox is spying on you through your mic to sell your voice to aliens! (Nope, Roblox just uses mics for voice chat.)

tactic-7.title: Multiple fake online identities
tactic-7.description: Using fake accounts to make it look like lots of people agree with something.
tactic-7.example: A TikTok post says, 'Mr. Beast is quitting music forever!' — but it's totally fake.

tactic-8.title: Scaring people
tactic-8.description: Trying to scare you so you react quickly without thinking.
tactic-8.example: A Snapchat story screams, 'If you don’t share this in 10 seconds, Snapchat will BLOCK YOUR ACCOUNT!' (Nope, it’s just trying to go viral.)

tactic-9.title: Fake accounts
tactic-9.description: Pretending to be someone you trust (like a friend, celebrity, or expert) to trick you.
tactic-9.example: An Instagram account named '@Real_Taylor_Swift' asks you for money.

tactic-10.title: Messing with your brain
tactic-10.description: Trying to make you doubt what you know is true.
tactic-10.example: A classmate accuses you of cheating, then denies it: 'I never said that! You’re imagining things—you must be stressed.'

tactic-11.title: Truth
tactic-11.description: It's the real deal! \nYou can look it up and see that it's real.
tactic-11.example: You can look it up and see that it's real!
